Heightsource: noise: internal scrolling noise. input: heightmap TOP on in2.
Style: smooth: plain noise. ridged: sharp ridge lines. terraced: stepped plateaus (see Terraces).
Height: Maximum displacement along the normals in world units.
Scale: Noise feature frequency. Larger = smaller, busier features. Noise source only.
Terraces: Number of steps when Style is terraced.
Speed: Scroll speed of the heightmap. 0 = static.
Look: original: height-based colours. mono: greyscale colours.
Accent: Amount (0-1) of red accent on the peaks of the Color attribute.
